ITEM 1 | Pale white, opaque, soft-looking mass with small irregular chunks and clumps, matte surface with slight sheen in places, crumbly edges, pieces roughly 2-4 cm, cut into rough irregular pieces rather than uniform shapes, no browning or char, sitting on a white square plate covering roughly 40% of the plate's surface, mounded to about 2-3 cm high | 250

ITEM 2 | Pale off-white, smooth-edged folded wedge-shaped piece with a slightly glossy, moist look, soft and dense-looking, about 6 cm long and 3-4 cm wide, a small piece lying beside it at its base, no browning, sitting on the white plate in the lower right area, about 1.5-2 cm high | 110

ITEM 3 | Pale white, dense, soft piece with a rounded top and irregular edges, matte surface with faint sheen, about 7 cm long by 4 cm wide, sitting in the upper right area of the white plate, about 2.5 cm high, no browning or grill marks | 120

ITEM 4 | Orange-red, thin, slightly glossy sauce with darker speckles and a smooth spread, visible on a white plate at the far left edge of the image, partly cut off, pooled across roughly one quarter of that plate | 40
